surface_value: If you do in fact have a mental illness that makes you unable to work you may qualify for state funding. Where I live, people that can not work due to mental illness are funded by DMHAS. You may have to do some researching, these services are sometimes hard to get if you are over 18 and it also depends on the state you live in.
